items.title: 德国法院裁定AI音乐生成器Suno侵犯版权，驳回合理使用抗辩
items.summary: 慕尼黑法院裁定，AI音乐生成器Suno在训练过程及输出结果中均侵犯版权，并驳回其合理使用抗辩。法院认定Suno 3.5和4版本模型可复现六首知名歌曲的原创元素，构成"记忆化"侵权，且责任归于Suno而非用户。该判决还认定美国版权法下的合理使用不适用于此案，目前尚未最终生效。

items.title: OpenAI Astra 以约2000美元证明10项数学难题
items.summary: OpenAI 用下一代模型 Astra 内部版解决了数学与理论计算机科学领域的10项重大进展，总成本约2000美元（按 Sol API 价格计算）。Astra 证明了非 sofic 群的存在，并推翻 Connes 刚性猜想，成果涵盖 von Neumann 代数、高维球堆积、电路复杂度等。OpenAI 已发布全部10项证明，附 Lean 证书与 CoT 逐步推导。

podcast.name: Unsupervised Learning
podcast.title: Ep 92: xAI Co-Founder Unpacks the Future of Model Development

zh.lead: 表面上大家都在聊基准测试——哪个模型碾压哪套考题。真正值钱的话题是「被发现」：Google News 被弃养的讨论（178 条评论）、「Google 如何杀死 RSS」的老文章重新登上热榜，而本周 Indie Hackers 最热的帖子是「How to rank #1 on ChatGPT」（怎么在 ChatGPT 上排第一，103 条评论）。智力早就不是瓶颈了，被找到才是。

build.title: AnswerTrack
build.oneLiner: 一份每周报告：把二十个买家最常问的问题抛给 ChatGPT、Perplexity 和 Gemini，看你的产品有没有出现在答案里。从此不用再猜，直接看到客户在哪儿找到你。

signals: Cursor 悄悄从用量页面和 CSV 导出中移除了费用信息——138 条评论，用户们抱怨在账单到手之前，再也看不到自己会被扣多少钱。
今天 Hacker News 最大的帖子不是 AI——一篇关于电梯调度算法的文章引发 387 条讨论，登上今日热榜。它讲的是「感知等待时间」，而不是机器时间。
发现渠道正在碎裂：「Google has abandoned Google News」（178 条评论）、「Google 如何杀死 RSS」的故事（137 条评论）、「How to rank #1 on ChatGPT」（103 条评论）——同一周，Amazon 的爬虫开始无视 robots.txt。

en.lead: The obvious conversation is benchmarks — which model outsmarts which test. The one that actually pays is discovery: Google News is being abandoned (178 comments), the story of how Google killed RSS resurfaced at 388 points, and the top Indie Hackers thread this week is "How to rank #1 on ChatGPT" (103 comments). Intelligence stopped being the bottleneck a while ago; being found is the bottleneck now.

build.title: AnswerTrack
build.oneLiner: a weekly report that asks twenty of your buyers' most common questions to ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini and shows whether your product shows up in the answers, so you stop guessing and start seeing where your customers find you.

signals: Cursor quietly removed cost information from its usage page and CSV export — 138 comments of users who can no longer see what they're billed before the invoice arrives.
The biggest Hacker News story of the day isn't AI — an essay on elevator scheduling algorithms drew 1,580 points and 387 comments, and its lessons are about perceived wait time, not machine time.

Discovery is fracturing: "Google has abandoned Google News" (178 comments), the how-Google-killed-RSS story (137 comments), and "How to rank #1 on ChatGPT" (103 comments) — the same week Amazon's crawler started ignoring robots.txt.
